source: Independent read-only review of only the revision-3 C1-C6 corrections. A1-A9 findings and unrelated topology were not re-reviewed.

evidence: The spec contract freeze names the added kinds and roles, preserves compatibility for absent kinds, defines role-derived low/secret/high-risk classes, and marks CVV transaction-only.
The spec maps plan-only, prompted, standing-policy automatic, and noninteractive fail-closed to plan/manual/auto/dontAsk and explicitly makes bypassPrompts internal-only.
G001 and G004 own the frozen model and policy contracts; their graph deliverables and tests cover every mode, high-risk step-up, and bypassPrompts rejection.
The spec and frozen decisions name the elf.import-provenance.v1, elf.import-loss.v1, elf.import-result.v1, encrypted envelope, handshake operations, and elf.padloc-broker-response.v2 contracts.
Import fields and envelope constants are partially enumerated, and unknown-key rejection is required.

The broker response section still defines only common fields, the kind list, target exception, and an error summary; it does not define exact required/optional fields and payload schemas for each kind.
The import-begin/import-commit handshake is described as steps, not as closed request/response shapes with required fields, types, errors, and one-time-custody result semantics.
findingResolutions.requiredChange: Add canonical versioned TypeScript or JSON schemas (or an equivalent field table) for every ImportResult/loss/provenance field, envelope field, handshake request and response, broker-response variant, and nested error/payload shape. Bind those schemas to the canonical fixture and transport operations so G005, G006, and G008 do not choose wire fields.

evidence: The revision-3 inventory adds the five paths named by the critic and assigns G007 ownership of form.ts plus value-free form outputs.
magic-browser/src/worker/typed-tools.ts:3178-3210 shows click_text and click_button_text returning pageSnapshot directly after the click.
magic-browser/src/runtime/cdp.ts:1775-1793 shows pageSnapshot exposing input and textarea value fields in the current seam.
magic-browser/src/worker/typed-tools.ts:3252-3392 shows scroll_table returning allRows strings and headings.

click_text, click_button_text, and scroll_table are absent from the C3 mustGate inventory and from the required negative tests, so model-visible page/table values can bypass the stated post-private-fill gate.
findingResolutions.requiredChange: Extend the exhaustive inventory and shared-gate ownership/tests to cover click_text, click_button_text, scroll_table, and any equivalent action result that returns a snapshot or page/table text. Require metadata-only or redacted output and unknown/potentially-private negatives.

evidence: The spec, plan, test specification, and G009 graph node use one canonical padloc-tree command and designate the Magic Browser runner as a helper only.
The bootstrap sequence requires exact-target privacy-status, trusted reset from unknown, and clean state before classify/plan; the evidence directory is padloc-owned and repository-prefixed.
G010 is limited to documenting the canonical command, so no second public runner is introduced.
The spec declares padloc/.ch5/proof.yaml the program authority and names all eight required command keys.
The test specification makes missing keys a G008 failure rather than optional UNKNOWN closure.
G008 owns the padloc authority file and may add only a Magic Browser consumer lane, preserving one registry.
The canonical fixture path is frozen as padloc/packages/extension/test/fixtures/agentic-autofill/contract.v1.json.
The frozen load rule requires PADLOC_TREE or a recorded sha256 for a local copy, with drift treated as failure.
G008 owns the canonical fixture and both consumer tests; the test specification requires hash parity and rejects drift.

rationale: Revision 3 closes C1, C4, C5, and C6 and materially improves C2 and C3. C2 remains under-specified at the per-variant wire and handshake-field level. C3 still omits value-bearing click and virtual-table worker outputs from the shared privacy gate. These are blocking plan-contract gaps, so implementation dispatch is not ready.
nextGate: Return to plan correction for C2 and C3; re-review the revision-4 spec, plan, test specification, and graph before plan-consensus.
